Honda Recalls Over 810,000 Vehicles for Airbag Inflator Defect

Honda is recalling more than 810,000 vehicles globally due to an issue with airbag inflators. The recall addresses a defect that could lead to a "deadly airbag issue," according to The Independent. The Economic Times also reported on the recall, specifying the number of vehicles involved.
